issues.title: chore: extend per-command flag validation to all CLI commands
issues.body:
## Background & Problem Statement

#33 (PR #37) added per-command flag validation to `src/cli.mjs`: `COMMAND_FLAGS`, `COMMON_FLAGS` and `SCOPED_FLAGS`. Only `link deactivate` has a table entry so far. Every other command still accepts any known flag and silently ignores the ones it doesn't use, e.g. `context --question x` or `link repair --manifest`. That is the failure mode #33 fixed for deactivation.

## Proposed Solution

Add a `COMMAND_FLAGS` entry for each dispatched command and subcommand, listing exactly the flags it reads. Then add a test that fails when a dispatched command has no entry, so the table can't drift.

## Requirements

- [ ] Every command dispatched by `run()` / `runEcosystem()` has an entry.
- [ ] Every invocation in `docs/`, `README.md`, `skills/` and the test suite still parses.
- [ ] Known-but-unused flags fail with `OPTION_NOT_SUPPORTED` before any write.

## Technical Design

Starting points: `src/cli.mjs` (`validateFlags`, `parse`), the command dispatch in `src/cli.mjs` and `src/ecosystem.mjs`, and `tests/docs.test.mjs` for a sweep of the documented commands. Review each command's real option reads, because a wrong entry breaks a working invocation.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Drift test: a dispatched command without a table entry fails the suite.
- [ ] Sweep test: every documented `holoself …` invocation parses.
- [ ] Release notes list the commands that became strict.

Refs #33

issues.title: feat: preview-then-apply for Workbench activate, deactivate, relink and setup
issues.body:
## Background & Problem Statement

#34 (PR #36) made Workbench **Repair** two-step: a dry-run preview with a `plan_hash`, then apply only if the plan is unchanged (`409 PLAN_CHANGED`). The other destructive space actions (`activate`, `deactivate`, `relink`, `setup`) still run `link … --yes` after a generic browser `confirm()`, without showing which files change. `relink` and `setup` also chain `link remove --yes` and `link add --yes`.

## Proposed Solution

Reuse the repair contract (preview → hash → apply-if-unchanged) for these actions, and show the file list (`activation_plan.writes`, or the deactivation plan from #33) before applying.

## Requirements

- [ ] No destructive space action writes without a preview the user has seen.
- [ ] A stale or missing plan hash is rejected with 409.
- [ ] The UI shows every file to change.

## Technical Design

Starting points: the `/api/spaces/:id/repair` route and `repairPlan` in `src/web-server.mjs`; `repairPreview` in `web/app.mjs`; the `link deactivate` dry-run plan (#33).

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Web tests for each action: preview writes nothing; a stale hash returns 409; a matching hash applies.
- [ ] A UI test asserts no bare `confirm()` remains for these actions.

Refs #34

issues.title: fix: data root nested inside a linked project resolves the project link
issues.body:
## Background & Problem Statement

Found during the review of #32 (PR #35). `holoself context --root . --task …` run from a data root that sits inside a linked project folder goes through `findLinkUpwards(cwd)` in `src/ecosystem.mjs` `contextData`. It picks up the enclosing project's `.holoself/link.yaml`, then fails with `SELF_ROOT_NOT_CANONICAL` (or resolves as that project) instead of treating the call as direct-owner root context.

## Proposed Solution

When `--root` is explicit and the cwd is inside that canonical root, resolve as owner-direct before searching upwards for a link. Alternatively, stop the upward search at the canonical root.

## Requirements

- [ ] A data root nested inside a linked project resolves as owner-direct when called with `--root .` from inside it.
- [ ] Linked-project resolution is unchanged for cwd inside the project but outside the root.

## Technical Design

Starting point: `contextData` identity resolution in `src/ecosystem.mjs` (the `findLinkUpwards` branch) and `isCanonicalSelf`.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Test: project P linked to self S, data root R nested at `P/R`; `holoself context --root . --task x --json` with cwd R → owner-direct packet for R.
- [ ] Existing linked-project and `LINK_REQUIRED` tests pass.

Refs #32
